# Frontier {#sec-frontier}

Rolling intake of recent work (roughly the last 12 months), captured before it is
distilled into a topic chapter.

**Migration rule:** when a frontier item is *superseded by a new approach* or has matured,
move it into its topic chapter's chronological timeline (Part II). This keeps the book
continuously evolving and prevents the frontier from becoming a junk drawer.

> **Stub.** Add dated entries below, newest first. Each: one-line claim, why it matters,
> target topic chapter, citation key.
